abstract: Efficient post-quantum cryptography on resource-constrained Internet-of-Things (IoT) devices requires implementations that exploit the target processor architecture while resisting practical implementation attacks. This paper presents an ISA-accelerated and implementation-hardened realization of Ring Binary Learning with Errors (RBLWE) encryption on a commodity ARM Cortex-M33 microcontroller. Packing four 8-bit polynomial coefficients into the byte lanes of a 32-bit register and processing them with SIMD-style instructions, together with a packed message codec, accelerates encryption and decryption, while a buffered hardware-TRNG entropy source drawn from the on-die Secure Element drives the key-generation gain. Together these give same-core cold-start speedups of $4.06\times$, $3.35\times$, and $3.01\times$ for key generation, encryption, and decryption over a scalar baseline, and $3.52\times$/$3.18\times$ lower encryption/decryption cycle counts than a reference Cortex-M0 implementation. On top of this accelerated core, we add four staged countermeasures: constant-time execution, fault hardening against zeroing, random-corruption, and instruction-skip faults, a Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO)-style CCA2 transform, and first-order shared (masked) CPA decryption, reporting each layer's cost individually. Binary-level inspection confirms these countermeasures survive compilation and identifies a compiler-induced masking flaw resolved with a hand-written assembly replacement. Dudect-style timing tests, debugger-assisted fault-injection campaigns, and component-level TVLA then provide implementation-level evidence for the staged protections. The results demonstrate a practical acceleration-security tradeoff for RBLWE on off-the-shelf microcontrollers and reusable architecture-aware techniques for lightweight post-quantum implementations.
title_cn: 商用 Cortex-M 微控制器上高效且实现加固的 RBLWE
abstract_cn: 在资源受限的 IoT 设备上实现高效后量子密码，需要既利用目标处理器架构又能抵抗实际实现攻击的实现。本文在商用 ARM Cortex-M33 微控制器上给出环形二元学习伴随错误（RBLWE）加密的 ISA 加速、实现加固版本。将四个 8 位多项式系数打包进 32 位寄存器的字节通道并以 SIMD 风格指令处理，配合打包消息编解码器加速加解密；由片上安全元件引出、经缓冲的硬件 TRNG 熵源驱动密钥生成的增益。这些使同核冷启动下密钥生成、加密、解密相对标量基线分别加速 4.06×、3.35×、3.01×，加解密周期数比参考 Cortex-M0 实现低 3.52×/3.18×。在加速核之上叠加四层分阶段对策：常量时间执行，抗清零、随机损坏与指令跳过故障的故障加固，Fujisaki-Okamoto（FO）式 CCA2 变换，以及一阶共享（掩码）CPA 解密，并逐层单独报告开销。二进制级检查确认对策在编译后仍然存在，并发现一处编译器引入的掩码缺陷，以手写汇编替换解决。dudect 式时序测试、调试器辅助故障注入实验与组件级 TVLA 为分阶段保护提供了实现层证据。结果展示了 RBLWE 在现成微控制器上的实用加速-安全权衡，以及可复用的架构感知轻量后量子实现技术。
summary_cn: Cortex-M33 上 ISA 加速并加固的 RBLWE：SIMD 打包使密钥生成/加密/解密加速 4.06×/3.35×/3.01×，叠加常量时间、故障加固、FO 变换与一阶掩码并逐层报开销，dudect/故障注入/TVLA 验证。
objective_summary: 在 Cortex-M33 上实现 SIMD 打包加速的 RBLWE 加解密并叠加常量时间、故障加固、FO 变换与一阶掩码四层对策，逐层量化开销并以 dudect、故障注入与 TVLA 验证。
evidence_note: 实机 Cortex-M33 的加速比（4.06×/3.35×/3.01×）与逐层开销量化，dudect 时序测试、调试器辅助故障注入与组件级 TVLA 三类实现层验证；单一 MCU 型号，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把既有加速（SIMD 系数打包）与加固（CT/故障/FO/掩码）技术组合到 RBLWE 这一新目标方案上，工程价值明确但方法层面为成熟技术的工程化。
scope: 结论适用于 Cortex-M33 类 MCU 与 RBLWE 参数集；对其他 PQC 方案、更高阶掩码与真实远程物理攻击者场景未验证。
limitations: 对策只到一阶掩码，高阶攻击未覆盖；故障模型限于清零/随机损坏/指令跳过三类；性能-安全权衡的参数点扫描有限。

title: SCSM: A Traffic-Native Foundation Model for Transferable Website Fingerprinting
abstract: Website fingerprinting infers the websites visited by users from encrypted traffic metadata. However, models trained under fixed collection conditions often degrade as website sets, collection times, network paths, browsers, or defenses change. Existing transferable attacks either rely on handcrafted perturbations of individual traces or adapt language-oriented architectures to traffic, limiting their ability to capture traffic-native semantics. To address these limitations, we propose SCSM, a traffic-native foundation model for transferable website fingerprinting. Specifically, SCSM constructs pairs of pretraining views from the same group of unlabeled traces through Segmentation, Combination, Scaling, and Masking. These operations produce diverse observable patterns while preserving the underlying packet events and local traffic dynamics of real trace fragments. The corresponding windowed traffic counting matrices serve as inputs for contrastive pretraining of a state-space encoder without website annotations. The pretrained encoder is then fine-tuned on a small labeled support set, and predictions are aggregated across temporal scales at inference. Experimental results demonstrate that SCSM surpasses the strongest baselines by 16.4\% in average top-3 accuracy over six temporal-drift tasks on GTT23 and by 13.8\% in average macro-F1 over four cross-domain datasets. The code and datasets will be made available at https://github.com/SJTU-dxw/WF-SCSM.
title_cn: SCSM：面向可迁移网站指纹识别的流量原生基础模型
abstract_cn: 网站指纹识别从加密流量元数据推断用户访问的网站。但在固定采集条件下训练的模型，会随网站集合、采集时间、网络路径、浏览器或防御的变化而退化。现有可迁移攻击要么依赖对单条流量的手工扰动，要么把面向语言的架构移植到流量上，限制其捕捉流量原生语义的能力。为此我们提出 SCSM，一个面向可迁移网站指纹识别的流量原生基础模型。具体地，SCSM 通过分割、组合、缩放与掩蔽，从同一组无标注流量构造预训练视图对：这些操作在保留真实流量片段的底层包事件与局部流量动态的同时，产生多样的可观测模式；对应的窗口化流量计数矩阵作为输入，用于无网站标注的状态空间编码器对比预训练。预训练编码器随后在小规模有标注支撑集上微调，推理时跨时间尺度聚合预测。实验表明，在 GTT23 的六个时间漂移任务上，SCSM 平均 top-3 准确率超过最强基线 16.4%；在四个跨域数据集上平均 macro-F1 超出 13.8%。代码与数据集将在 https://github.com/SJTU-dxw/WF-SCSM 发布。
summary_cn: SCSM 用分割/组合/缩放/掩蔽视图对比预训练流量原生状态空间编码器做可迁移网站指纹识别：GTT23 六个时间漂移任务 top-3 准确率 +16.4%，跨域 macro-F1 +13.8%。
objective_summary: 构建以窗口化流量计数矩阵为输入、经分割/组合/缩放/掩蔽视图对比预训练的状态空间编码器 SCSM，在时间漂移与跨域任务上量化可迁移网站指纹识别性能。
evidence_note: GTT23 六个时间漂移任务与四个跨域数据集、与最强基线的平均准确率对比（+16.4% top-3、+13.8% macro-F1）；无统计检验，数据集为公开 WF 基准组合。
novelty_note: 把自监督对比预训练与流量原生增广（而非手工扰动或语言架构移植）引入网站指纹识别，属该攻击方向的基础模型式新路线，直指时间/域漂移退化问题。
scope: 结论适用于所测公开 WF 数据集（GTT23 与四个跨域集）与网页流量场景；对视频流、QUIC 大包序与更主动的防御（常数时序填充）的鲁棒性未验证。
limitations: 预训练仍需大量无标注同域流量；微调需小规模标注支撑集；对最强防御（如包序重塑、恒定速率）下的成功率未报告。

title: What Response Marginals Miss: Adaptive Query Complexity of Functional Backdoor Recovery
abstract: Functional backdoor recovery finds any trigger whose attack success rate is at least a given threshold rather than to recover the planted trigger. We study the minimum number of queries required for this task under label feedback which returns the predicted class label. We construct two finite families of victim models that have exactly the same attack success rate for every victim and trigger candidate. The distribution of returned labels for every query is also identical under a uniformly chosen victim. These families form an explicit counterexample that despite the matched quantities, their optimal adaptive query complexities are \(\Theta(\log H)\) and \(\Theta(H)\) where \(H\) is the number of possible victims. The difference arises because the same non-target labels are associated with different sets of victims, so successive queries eliminate possible victims at different rates. This separation disappears when the response is reduced to binary feedback, which reports only whether the target label is returned. The separation also persists for every fixed failure probability below one. Finally, we realize the same recovery problems with trained CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 classifiers and verify the predicted optimal query budgets. These results show that attack success rate and the distribution of returned labels for each query are insufficient to determine the query complexity of functional backdoor recovery.
title_cn: 响应边际遗漏了什么：函数式后门恢复的自适应查询复杂度
abstract_cn: 函数式后门恢复的目标是找到任意攻击成功率不低于给定阈值的触发器，而非复原被植入的触发器。我们研究在标签反馈——返回预测类别标签——下该任务所需的最小查询数。我们构造两个有限受害模型族：对每个受害模型与每个触发候选，两者的攻击成功率完全相同，且在均匀随机选定受害模型时每次查询返回标签的分布也相同。这两个族构成显式反例：尽管上述量匹配，其最优自适应查询复杂度分别为 Θ(log H) 与 Θ(H)，其中 H 为可能受害模型数。差异源于相同的非目标标签关联不同的受害模型集合，使逐次查询消除候选的速度不同。当响应退化为只报告是否返回目标标签的二元反馈时，该分离消失；对每个小于 1 的固定失败概率，分离也保持。最后，我们用训练好的 CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 分类器实现同样的恢复问题，并验证预测的最优查询预算。这些结果表明攻击成功率与每次查询的返回标签分布不足以决定函数式后门恢复的查询复杂度。
summary_cn: 证明函数式后门恢复的查询复杂度可差 Θ(log H) 对 Θ(H)：两个标签分布完全一致的模型族构成显式分离，二元反馈下分离消失，CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 验证预测预算。
objective_summary: 构造攻击成功率与查询标签分布完全一致但最优自适应查询复杂度相差 Θ(log H) 对 Θ(H) 的受害模型族，证明分离条件并训练 CIFAR-10 ResNet-18 验证预测预算。
evidence_note: 显式反例族的完整复杂度证明（含任意固定失败概率的推广）与训练分类器上的实验验证，理论-实验闭环；无统计检验需求（理论主导）。
novelty_note: 为函数式后门恢复给出首个标签反馈下的自适应查询复杂度分离，指出「ASR+标签分布匹配不足以定复杂度」这一反直觉事实及二元反馈下分离消失的边界条件。
scope: 结论适用于有限受害模型族、标签/二元反馈下的触发器恢复问题；对连续触发空间、梯度反馈与多后门场景未涵盖。
limitations: 反例族为构造性最小实例，与真实后门模型的距离未量化；Θ(H) 下界的实际攻击意义依赖 H 的规模；未给出复杂度最优攻击的具体算法实现。

title: When Can Stateless Recovery Defeat Byzantine Quorum Safety? A Tight Normal Form for Single-Step BFT
abstract: Byzantine quorum safety relies on correct replicas refusing to sign conflicting values. A replica that loses its protocol state during recovery but retains its identity and signing key may forget an earlier vote. We study certificates formed by matching signed votes from at least $q$ of $n$ replicas, assuming that each correct replica avoids conflicting votes between recoveries. If two conflicting certificates form, their overlap has size between $2q-n$ and $b+c$, where $b$ counts Byzantine replicas and $c$ counts correct identities that recovered during the execution considered. Our main result decomposes the slack $b+c-(2q-n)$ into four nonnegative counts: extra signers in the first certificate, extra signers in the second, identities in neither certificate, and Byzantine or recovering identities outside their overlap. Zero slack forces an exact signer partition. With $n=3f+1$ replicas, threshold $q=2f+1$, at most $f$ Byzantine replicas, and exactly one correct recovery event, any conflicting pair forces exactly $f$ Byzantine replicas, all in the overlap together with the recovered replica; each certificate has a disjoint side of $f$ correct replicas. A minimal protocol attains this form. We distinguish certificate formation from acceptance, give a sufficient check using configured fault and recovery caps, and explain why durable vote records written before signature release prevent the conflict.

title_cn: 无状态恢复何时能击败拜占庭仲裁安全性？单步 BFT 的紧标准形
abstract_cn: 拜占庭仲裁（quorum）安全性依赖正确副本拒绝对冲突值签名。副本在恢复期间丢失协议状态但保留身份与签名密钥时，可能忘记早前的投票。我们研究由至少 q 个、共 n 个副本的匹配签名投票构成的证书，假设每个正确副本在恢复之间避免冲突投票。若两个冲突证书形成，其交集大小介于 2q−n 与 b+c 之间，其中 b 计拜占庭副本、c 计所考察执行中恢复了的正确身份。主结果把松弛量 b+c−(2q−n) 分解为四个非负计数：第一证书的多余签名者、第二证书的多余签名者、不在任一证书中的身份、以及在交集之外的拜占庭或恢复中身份。零松弛迫使签名者精确划分。在 n=3f+1、阈值 q=2f+1、至多 f 个拜占庭副本、恰好一次正确恢复事件的设定下，任何冲突对都恰好迫使 f 个拜占庭副本连同恢复副本全部出现在交集中，且每个证书各有互不相交的 f 个正确副本。一个最小协议达到该标准形。我们区分证书形成与接受，给出使用配置故障与恢复上限的充分检查，并解释为何在签名释放前写入持久投票记录可防止冲突。
summary_cn: 证明无状态恢复下拜占庭仲裁安全的紧标准形：冲突证书交集受 2q−n 与 b+c 夹逼并四分解松弛量；n=3f+1 单恢复事件下冲突对结构被精确刻画，签名前持久化投票可防冲突。
objective_summary: 对正确副本在恢复间不冲突投票的假设下研究冲突仲裁证书的交集结构，给出松弛量的四分解标准形、单恢复事件下的精确刻画与最小协议实例及持久化防护准则。
evidence_note: 组合学式的精确刻画（交集上下界、松弛量四分解、零松弛强制精确划分）与 n=3f+1 设定下的必然结构，附达到标准形的最小协议；ICDCN 2027 short paper 录用；纯理论。
novelty_note: 把「无状态恢复何时破坏仲裁安全」整理为可检验的标准形并给出紧刻画，区分证书形成与接受两个此前常被混用的概念，属对已知安全论证的系统化收紧。
scope: 结论适用于匹配签名投票证书与「恢复间不冲突投票」假设下的单步 BFT；多步协议、阈值签名与密码学密钥演化场景未覆盖。
limitations: 短论文篇幅，证明细节与协议描述精简；假设正确副本恢复间不投冲突票，该前提在工程上需持久化机制保障；未给出定量实验。

title: The Model Plants the Trigger: Answer-Side Backdoor Attacks in Multi-Turn Large Language Models
abstract: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) remains vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Existing LLM backdoors are almost all input-centric: activation depends on explicit trigger patterns in the user input, so modern guardrails are built to sanitize the input space. We challenge this assumption with a novel answer-side backdoor for multi-turn dialogue. Instead of inserting the trigger into the input, the adversary uses a benign first-turn prompt to naturally induce the model to generate a specific, seemingly innocuous word. Once merged into the dialogue history, this self-generated word becomes the trigger. When a later harmful query arrives, the model detects its own trigger and bypasses its safety refusal, while the user input stays perfectly clean. Across four LLMs, our attack reaches near-perfect Attack Success Rates, approaching 100\% at only a 5\% poisoning rate, while preserving general utility and clean-input safety, and it evades mainstream input-centric defenses. Representation-level analysis shows that the self-generated trigger consistently suppresses the model's refusal signal, exposing a critical blind spot in current LLM defenses.
title_cn: 模型自己种下触发器：多轮大语言模型的答案侧后门攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐仍易受后门攻击。现有 LLM 后门几乎都以输入为中心：激活依赖用户输入中的显式触发模式，因此现代护栏都围绕清洗输入空间构建。我们用一种面向多轮对话的全新「答案侧」后门挑战这一假设。对手不把触发器插入输入，而是用一个良性的首轮提示自然诱导模型生成一个特定、看似无害的词；这个词并入对话历史后即成为触发器。当后续有害查询到来时，模型检测到自己的触发器并绕过安全拒答，而用户输入保持完全干净。在四个 LLM 上，该攻击达到接近完美的攻击成功率——仅 5% 投毒率下即接近 100%——同时保持通用效用与干净输入安全，并绕过主流以输入为中心的防御。表示层分析显示自生成触发器持续抑制模型的拒答信号，暴露了当前 LLM 防御的关键盲区。
summary_cn: 答案侧后门：良性首轮流诱导模型自生触发词并入对话历史，后续有害查询即绕过拒答；四个 LLM 上 5% 投毒率 ASR 近 100%，保持效用并绕过输入侧防御。
objective_summary: 提出以模型自生成词为触发器的多轮对话答案侧后门：毒化数据使模型在良性首轮流生成特定词并据此绕过拒答，在四个 LLM 上量化 ASR、效用与对输入侧防御的绕过，并做表示层分析。
evidence_note: 四个 LLM 上的 ASR（5% 投毒率近 100%）、效用与干净输入安全保持、主流输入侧防御绕过实验与表示层拒答信号分析；无统计检验，防御评估限于输入中心方法。
novelty_note: 开辟「答案侧触发」这一新威胁面：触发器由模型自己生成并驻留对话历史，用户输入全程干净，结构性绕过一切输入空间清洗类防御。
scope: 结论适用于多轮对话式 LLM 与可诱导自生成特定词的模型；对带对话历史消毒、轮级重置或输出审查的防御未评估；触发词泛化性依赖训练构造。
limitations: 需要毒化训练数据（投毒入口前提）；触发词由攻击者指定，可能被输出侧异常检测捕获但未测；表示层分析非因果证明。

title: PerSpectron: Detecting Invariant Footprints of Microarchitectural Attacks with Perceptron
abstract: Detecting microarchitectural attacks is critical given their proliferation in recent years. Many of these attacks exhibit intrinsic behaviors essential to the nature of their operation, such as creating contention or misspeculation. This study systematically investigates the microarchitectural footprints of hardware-based attacks and shows how they can be detected and classified using an efficient hardware predictor. We present a methodology to use correlated microarchitectural statistics to design a hardware-based neural predictor capable of detecting and classifying microarchitectural attacks before data is leaked. Once a potential attack is detected, it can be proactively mitigated by triggering appropriate countermeasures. Our hardware-based detector, PerSpectron, uses perceptron learning to identify and classify attacks. Perceptron-based prediction has been successfully used in branch prediction and other hardware-based applications. PerSpectron has minimal performance overhead. The statistics being monitored have similar overhead to already existing performance monitoring counters. Additionally, PerSpectron operates outside the processor's critical paths, offering security without added computation delay. Our system achieves a usable detection rate for detecting attacks such as SpectreV1, SpectreV2, SpectreRSB, Meltdown, breakingKSLR, Flush+Flush, Flush+Reload, Prime+Probe as well as cache-attack calibration programs. We also believe that the large number of diverse microarchitectural features offers both evasion resilience and interpretability---features not present in previous hardware security detectors. We detect these attacks early enough to avoid any data leakage, unlike previous work that triggers countermeasures only after data has been exposed.

title_cn: PerSpectron：用感知机检测微架构攻击的不变足迹
abstract_cn: 鉴于微架构攻击近年激增，检测它们至关重要。许多攻击表现出其运作本质所要求的内在行为，如制造争用或错误推测。本研究系统考察基于硬件的攻击的微架构足迹，并展示如何用高效的硬件预测器检测和分类它们。我们提出一种利用相关微架构统计量设计硬件神经预测器的方法，能在数据泄露前检测并分类微架构攻击；一旦检测到潜在攻击，即可触发相应对策主动缓解。其硬件检测器 PerSpectron 用感知机学习识别与分类攻击。感知机预测已成功用于分支预测等硬件场景。PerSpectron 性能开销极小：所监控统计量的开销与现有性能监控计数器相当，且运行在处理器关键路径之外，不增加计算时延即提供安全。该系统对 SpectreV1、SpectreV2、SpectreRSB、Meltdown、breakingKSLR、Flush+Flush、Flush+Reload、Prime+Probe 以及缓存攻击标定程序实现了可用的检测率。我们认为大量多样化微架构特征同时提供规避韧性与可解释性——这是以往硬件安全检测器不具备的。我们能在泄露发生前足够早地检测这些攻击，而以往工作只在数据暴露后才触发对策。
summary_cn: PerSpectron（MICRO 2020）用感知机在关键路径外检测微架构攻击：覆盖 Spectre V1/V2/RSB、Meltdown、Flush+Reload、Prime+Probe 等，开销与性能计数器相当，可在泄露前触发对策。
objective_summary: 系统刻画微架构攻击的硬件足迹并设计基于感知机的片上预测器 PerSpectron，在数据泄露前检测并分类 Spectre/Meltdown/缓存侧信道等攻击，报告检测率与开销。
evidence_note: MICRO 2020 录用；覆盖 SpectreV1/V2/RSB、Meltdown、breakingKSLR、Flush+Flush/Reload、Prime+Probe 及标定程序的多攻击类检测与分类，开销量化（与性能计数器相当、关键路径外）；检测率为定性「可用」描述、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 把分支预测式感知机移植为微架构攻击检测器并强调「泄露前检测」：多样化微架构特征带来规避韧性与可解释性，区别于事后触发对策的既有硬件检测路线。
scope: 结论适用于所测攻击家族与目标处理器微架构的统计足迹；对未见攻击变体、故意模仿良性足迹的规避攻击及不同微架构的迁移未验证。
limitations: 检测率为定性描述、未给出精确数值与假报率；训练需覆盖攻击足迹样本；感知机容量有限，复杂多阶段攻击的分类边界未测。

title: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
abstract: In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the external classifier used to evaluate reconstructions: for the same reconstructed images, an adversarially trained Inception evaluator identifies the targeted identity at different rates than the standard Inception evaluator. Our results suggest that standard MIA evaluation can mistake optimization and measurement failures for privacy. These underestimated leakage rates also concealed a broader relationship between privacy and adversarial robustness. Once we adapt the attack and vary the evaluator, reconstruction leakage closely tracks adversarial robustness across recent defenses and standard training regimes, suggesting that robustness provides an attack-agnostic proxy for reconstruction vulnerability that applies far more broadly than previously theorized. This raises an open question: can a practical defense reduce training-data reconstruction without paying a corresponding cost in adversarial robustness?
title_cn: 自适应模型反演攻击泛化了隐私—鲁棒性权衡
abstract_cn: 本文证明对高分辨率模型反演攻击（MIA）的标准评估显著低估训练数据隐私泄露。在 FaceScrub 上，对攻击做简单自适应改动后，最先进隐私防御、MixUp 与对抗训练等标准训练技术乃至无防御模型，泄露训练图像的比率提高 1.16 到 6.59 倍，其中声称隐私最强的防御增幅最大。我们进一步表明测得的泄露取决于评估重建所用的外部分类器特征基：对同一批重建图像，对抗训练的 Inception 评估器识别目标身份的比率与标准 Inception 不同。这些结果说明标准 MIA 评估可能把优化与测量失败误认为隐私。被低估的泄露率还掩盖了隐私与对抗鲁棒性之间更广的关系：一旦自适应攻击并更换评估器，重建泄露在近期防御与标准训练机制间紧密跟踪对抗鲁棒性，提示鲁棒性为重建脆弱性提供了适用范围远超以往理论的攻击无关代理。这引出一个开放问题：是否存在能在不付出相应对抗鲁棒性代价的前提下降低训练数据重建的实用防御？
summary_cn: 自适应化模型反演攻击后，FaceScrub 上各防御与标准训练的泄露率升 1.16–6.59 倍且最强防御增幅最大；重建泄露紧跟踪对抗鲁棒性，揭示未解的隐私-鲁棒性权衡。
objective_summary: 以自适应攻击改动与评估器特征基对照，重测 FaceScrub 上多个隐私防御与标准训练的训练图像泄露率，并刻画重建泄露与对抗鲁棒性之间的经验关系。
evidence_note: FaceScrub 上跨最新防御、MixUp/对抗训练与无防御模型的受控重测，泄漏率变化 1.16–6.59 倍、评估器特征基对照实验、鲁棒性-泄露相关性跨多种机制成立；无统计检验细节。
novelty_note: 实证修正领域默认结论：标准 MIA 评估把优化/测量失败误当隐私，且重建泄露与对抗鲁棒性在防御间普遍相关——把两个此前分离的研究方向连成一条可检验关系。
scope: 结论适用于高分辨率人脸数据（FaceScrub）与 Inception 特征基评估；重建泄露与鲁棒性的关系为经验观察，因果机制与理论解释未给出。
limitations: 限于单数据集与所测防御集合；自适应攻击仅覆盖「简单改动」，更强自适应策略可能进一步放大差距；开放问题（免鲁棒性代价的防御）未解决。

title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.

title_cn: 规则止于何处、评审始于何处：度量多智能体系统安全中的判断边界
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）调用工具、共享记忆、委托任务，常会遭遇对抗内容。当前 MAS 防御通常被孤立评估，一次只看一类攻击，可能导致代价高昂且难以审计的结果。本研究把防御组织为五条原则，并实现为 DEFER1（确定性优先执行+残余判断），包含 28 项检查的级联：能拦则拦，其余交给四个评审组成的评审团。在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率从约 30.0% 降到约 3.0%，78% 被拦攻击由确定性检查处理。在安全运营领域只有四分之一的提案到达评审团，说明规则为违反明确政策的攻击提供安全，而评审团处理那些只歪曲意图的攻击。两套系统都有弱点，例如风险分批准门会错误批准大多数攻击提案却极少批准正当提案，凸显准确评估威胁的困难。
summary_cn: DEFER1 把 MAS 防御组织为 28 项确定性检查+四评审团级联：四领域测试 ASR 从约 30% 降到约 3%，78% 拦截由确定性规则完成；风险分批准门仍会错批多数攻击。
objective_summary: 把 MAS 防御组织为五原则并实现 28 项确定性检查+四评审团级联的 DEFER1，在四领域独立测试中量化规则与 LLM 评审各自的拦截贡献及两类系统的失效模式。
evidence_note: 四领域独立测试（ASR 约 30%→约 3%）、规则与评审贡献分解（78% 由确定性检查拦截）、含对风险分批准门等组件的失效分析；无统计检验，攻击集与领域为自选。
novelty_note: 以「判断边界」视角量化确定性规则与 LLM 评审的分工——规则管政策违例、评审管意图歪曲——为 MAS 防御组合提供了可审计的架构分解与经验边界。
scope: 结论适用于所测四领域、五原则实例化 DEFER1 与四评审配置；对自适应攻击者、评审团合谋与更大规模 MAS 的成本伸缩未评估。
limitations: 28 项检查的设计依赖领域知识且可能过拟合所选攻击；评审团本身存在误判（如风险分门错批攻击）；防御延迟与 token 成本未系统报告。

title: SkillPoison: Progressive Skill Poisoning via Successful Experiences
abstract: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly distill successful experiences into persistent, reusable skills. Existing skill attack methods corrupt this learning pipeline by injecting malicious triggers, behaviors, or false facts into individual experiences or extracted skills. However, such attacks are easily detected, and the injected malicious behaviors often fail to accumulate as persistent skills. In this paper, we show that skill poisoning can arise even from verified successful experiences, without making any individual trajectory malicious. Based on this insight, we propose SkillPoison, a novel framework that progressively poisons skill via successful experiences. SkillPoison first constructs a set of successful experiences that reinforce a target behavior, and then removes the contextual conditions that constrain when the behavior applies. Rather than injecting malicious content, SkillPoison shapes how the skill extractor generalizes, allowing useful behavior to support task success while inducing harmful behavior when they are misapplied. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show that SkillPoison achieves 95.71% attack success rates, while all injected experiences remain task-correct and pass verification and lexical inspection. Our code, data and implementation details are available for the community at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/SkillPoison.
title_cn: SkillPoison：经由成功经验的渐进技能投毒
abstract_cn: 自我改进的 LLM 智能体日益把成功经验蒸馏为持久、可复用的技能。现有技能攻击方法通过向单条经验或已提取技能注入恶意触发、行为或虚假事实来腐蚀这一学习管线，但这些注入易被检测，注入的恶意行为也常无法积累为持久技能。本文证明：即使全部来自经验证的成功经验、不使任何单条轨迹带恶意，技能投毒也能成立。基于这一洞察，我们提出 SkillPoison，一个经由成功经验渐进投毒技能的框架。SkillPoison 先构造一组强化目标行为的成功经验，再移除约束该行为适用时机的上下文条件。它不注入恶意内容，而是塑造技能提取器的泛化方式，让有用行为在支持任务成功的同时，在被误用时诱发有害行为。在三个基准上的大量实验显示，SkillPoison 达到 95.71% 攻击成功率，而所有注入经验都保持任务正确并通过验证与词法检查。代码、数据与实现细节见 https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/SkillPoison。
summary_cn: SkillPoison 只用验证通过的成功经验渐进投毒技能库：构造强化目标行为的经验再剥离其适用条件，三基准上 ASR 95.71%，全部注入经验保持任务正确并通过验证与词法检查。
objective_summary: 提出不注入恶意内容、而是用任务正确的成功经验塑造技能提取器泛化方式的技能投毒框架 SkillPoison，在三个基准上量化攻击成功率并通过验证与词法检查评估隐蔽性。
evidence_note: 三个基准上的攻击成功率 95.71%，注入经验全部通过任务正确性验证与词法检查；自建攻击评估、无统计检验，代码与数据公开。
novelty_note: 把技能投毒从「注入恶意内容」重新定义为「塑造提取器泛化」：攻击痕迹存在于条件剥离而非内容本身，绕开现有检测假设，揭示自改进智能体技能管线的新攻击面。
scope: 结论适用于依赖成功经验蒸馏与技能提取的自我改进智能体管线；对带来源审计、多阶段验证或技能回滚机制的防御效果未评估。
limitations: 攻击需能向经验库投放经验（入口前提未讨论）；「误用时诱发有害行为」依赖使用场景与技能描述的匹配；对更强语义级异常检测的鲁棒性未测。

title: HarnessSecurity-Bench: Do Security Mechanisms Really Protect Coding Agent Harnesses?
abstract: Coding agent harnesses mediate tool use and authorize actions, yet their security mechanisms and runtime effects remain incompletely characterized. We present HarnessSecurity, the first systematic empirical study and benchmark of open- and closed-source coding agent harnesses. First, we derive a ten-mechanism taxonomy and then assess 400 harness-mechanism cells using independent ratings by researchers and large language model (LLM) judges. We find that about half of confirmed mechanism implementations are opt-in, while closed-source harnesses exhibit substantial evidence gaps. Second, we introduce HarnessSecurity-Bench, a benchmark of 23 tasks across five attack surfaces without sacrificing legitimate task requirements. Using separate deterministic oracles to measure task utility and attack effects with security setting comparisons, we evaluate nine mechanisms across six leading harnesses: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, gptme, Qwen Code, and GitHub Copilot. Under a controlled LLM baseline GLM-5.2, we conduct 2,500 trials, recording 81,155 tool calls and over 2.2 billion tokens. Enabling auto-approve increases utility and raises attack success from 29.2% to 95.6%. Network isolation and read-only mode reduce attack effects with substantial utility losses, while command allowlisting and command denylisting reduce attack effects with a small utility loss and a utility gain, respectively. Task-level cases show that restrictions on a shared capability can obstruct both legitimate and malicious operations, and that allowed tools or commands can leave unauthorized operations reachable through alternative execution paths. Harness providers should make security settings verifiable, test alternative execution paths to protected operations, and assess attack effects alongside task utility and execution costs.

title_cn: HarnessSecurity-Bench：安全机制真的保护编码智能体脚手架吗？
abstract_cn: 编码智能体脚手架（harness）中介工具使用并授权动作，但其安全机制与运行时效应尚未被完整刻画。我们提出 HarnessSecurity，首个对开源与闭源编码智能体脚手架的系统实证研究与基准。首先，我们推导十机制分类法，用研究者与 LLM 评审的独立评分评估 400 个脚手架-机制单元。我们发现约一半已确认的机制实现是可选开启的，而闭源脚手架存在大量证据缺口。其次，我们提出 HarnessSecurity-Bench，一个涵盖五个攻击面、23 个任务、不牺牲正当任务需求的基准。用分离的确定性神谕分别度量任务效用与攻击效果并比较安全设置，我们在六个主流脚手架（Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI、gptme、Qwen Code、GitHub Copilot）上评估九种机制。在受控 LLM 基线 GLM-5.2 下进行 2,500 次试验，记录 81,155 次工具调用与超过 22 亿 token。开启自动批准提高效用并使攻击成功率从 29.2% 升到 95.6%；网络隔离与只读模式降低攻击效果但效用损失可观；命令白名单与黑名单分别以小幅效用损失和效用增益降低攻击效果。任务级案例显示，对共享能力的限制会同时阻碍正当与恶意操作，且被允许的工具或命令可能经由替代执行路径触达未授权操作。脚手架提供方应使安全设置可验证、测试受保护操作的替代执行路径，并连同任务效用与执行成本一起评估攻击效果。
summary_cn: 首个编码智能体脚手架安全系统研究：400 机制单元约半数为可选开启；6 脚手架 2,500 试验显示自动批准使 ASR 29.2%→95.6%，隔离/只读降攻击但损效用，白名单代价小。
objective_summary: 对六个主流编码智能体脚手架做十机制分类法评估（400 单元）并构建五攻击面 23 任务的 HarnessSecurity-Bench，在受控 LLM 基线下以 2,500 次试验量化九种安全机制的攻击效果与效用代价。
evidence_note: 2,500 次试验、81,155 工具调用、22 亿 token 的大规模受控实验，确定性神谕分离度量效用与攻击效果，六脚手架×九机制系统覆盖，研究者与 LLM 评审双通道标注；无统计检验细节。
novelty_note: 首个对编码智能体脚手架安全机制的分类学+基准+大规模实证：给出自动批准/隔离/只读/白黑名单的效用-攻击效果量化曲线与替代执行路径逃逸案例，是该方向的首次系统化。
scope: 结论适用于所测六个脚手架、九种机制与受控 LLM 基线 GLM-5.2 的任务型攻击面；闭源脚手架内部实现不可见，机制组合与多智能体编排场景未覆盖。
limitations: 攻击面与任务为基准构造，未含真实供应链攻击；LLM 评审标注可能有系统性偏差；安全设置随厂商版本快速演进，结论时效性有限。

title: CISB-Bench: An Auditable Source--IR Dataset of Compiler-Introduced Security Bugs
abstract: Compiler-introduced security bugs (CISBs) arise when an optimization, lowering, or instrumentation decision changes a security-relevant property of the generated program. They are difficult to study because their evidence is distributed across issue reports, reduced tests, historical configurations, and compiler artifacts; a security-related report also does not imply that every associated reduction establishes a security-bearing compiler failure. We present CISB-Bench, an auditable dataset of 429 exact C-program rows mined from GCC and LLVM. Each row contains its C reduction, a standardized LLVM IR analysis bundle at -O0 through -O3, public provenance, a final binary label, and a primary mechanism or boundary annotation. Two reviewers independently labeled the fixed corpus, agreeing on 369 rows (86.0%, Cohen's kappa=0.662); the 60 disagreements were adjudicated. The final dataset comprises 280 CISBs and 149 hard non-CISB cases. The prediction task is to recover this reviewed exact-row label from the supplied artifacts; it is not a claim that standardized IR alone reproduces every historical compiler failure. We characterize the security mechanisms and evidence boundaries represented by the corpus, and demonstrate how its paired artifacts support source-only, IR-aware, and joint analyses. CISB-Bench provides a reusable, inspectable target for compiler-security mining and detection research.
title_cn: CISB-Bench：可审计的编译器引入安全缺陷源码—IR 数据集
abstract_cn: 编译器引入的安全缺陷（CISB）指优化、lowering 或插桩决策改变生成程序安全相关性质的情形。这类缺陷难以研究，因为证据分散在 issue 报告、精简测试用例、历史配置与编译器工件中；而且一份安全相关报告并不意味着每个关联精简用例都确立了承载安全性的编译器失败。我们提出 CISB-Bench，一个从 GCC 与 LLVM 挖掘的 429 行精确 C 程序的可审计数据集。每行含其 C 精简用例、-O0 到 -O3 的标准化 LLVM IR 分析包、公开来源、最终二元标签与主要机制或边界标注。两名评审独立标注修复语料，369 行一致（86.0%，Cohen's kappa=0.662），60 处分歧经仲裁解决。最终数据集含 280 个 CISB 与 149 个难例非 CISB。预测任务是从所供工件恢复经评审的精确行标签；这并不主张标准化 IR 单独复现每个历史编译器失败。我们刻画语料代表的安全机制与证据边界，并演示其成对工件如何支持仅源码、IR 感知与联合分析。CISB-Bench 为编译器安全挖掘与检测研究提供了可复用、可检视的目标。
summary_cn: CISB-Bench：从 GCC/LLVM 挖掘的 429 行可审计编译器引入安全缺陷数据集（280 CISB+149 难例），双人标注 86.0% 一致（kappa 0.662）后仲裁，附 -O0 至 -O3 IR 分析包。
objective_summary: 从 GCC/LLVM 挖掘并双人标注 429 行 C 精简用例（280 CISB/149 难例），附多级优化 IR 分析包、来源与机制标注，构成可审计的编译器安全缺陷预测目标。
evidence_note: 双人独立标注+仲裁流程（86.0% 一致、kappa 0.662）、逐行公开来源与二元标签、-O0 至 -O3 标准化 IR 工件、明确界定证据边界；数据集性质使经验主张受控。
novelty_note: 首个针对编译器引入安全缺陷的可审计基准：把「安全相关报告≠安全承载失败」的证据边界做成显式标注，并为源码/IR/联合三类分析提供成对工件。
scope: 结论适用于 GCC/LLVM 的 C 程序精简用例与 LLVM IR 表示；其他编译器、语言前端与更复杂构建配置的扩展未覆盖。
limitations: 429 行规模对深度学习检测器偏小；IR 分析包为标准化快照，不含完整构建上下文；kappa 0.662 表明标签边界存在主观性。

title: CheckerBench: Can Long-Horizon Agents Synthesize Static-Analysis Checkers?
abstract: Static-analysis checker synthesis requires agents to interpret a defect specification, inspect a repository, implement analyzer-specific logic, and refine the checker through repeated compilation and analysis feedback. Existing coding-agent benchmarks focus on tasks such as patch generation or vulnerability detection and rarely assess whether an agent can develop a working checker in a repository from start to finish. We introduce CheckerBench, an executable benchmark of 300 tasks derived from 297 CVEs across 167 repositories, 85 CWEs, and five language ecosystems. Each task includes vulnerable and fixed revisions, a pinned analysis environment, and a checker scaffold. We further introduce CheckerLab, a common evaluation framework that independently rebuilds submitted checkers and measures vulnerable-fixed diagnostic contrast, patch localization, false positives, and tool use. Across 21 model-harness configurations and three independent repeats per configuration, mean Pass@1 is 32.30%, while the best reaches 45.33%. These results show that reliable, reusable checker development remains challenging for current coding agents.
title_cn: CheckerBench：长程智能体能合成静态分析检查器吗？
abstract_cn: 静态分析检查器合成要求智能体解读缺陷规范、检视仓库、实现分析器专用逻辑，并通过反复编译与分析反馈精炼检查器。现有编码智能体基准聚焦补丁生成或漏洞检测等任务，很少评估智能体能否在仓库中从头到尾开发一个可用的检查器。我们提出 CheckerBench，一个包含 300 个任务的可执行基准，任务源自 167 个仓库、85 个 CWE、五个语言生态的 297 个 CVE。每个任务含漏洞版与修复版、固定的分析环境与检查器脚手架。我们进一步提出 CheckerLab，一个独立重建提交检查器的公共评估框架，度量漏洞-修复诊断对比、补丁定位、误报与工具使用。跨 21 个模型-脚手架配置、每配置三次独立重复，平均 Pass@1 为 32.30%，最好成绩 45.33%。这些结果表明可靠、可复用的检查器开发对当前编码智能体仍然困难。
summary_cn: CheckerBench 评测智能体端到端合成静态分析检查器：300 任务源自 297 CVE/167 仓库/85 CWE/5 生态，21 个配置平均 Pass@1 仅 32.30%、最好 45.33%。
objective_summary: 构建源自 297 个 CVE 的 300 任务可执行检查器合成基准与独立重建评估框架 CheckerLab，在 21 个模型-脚手架配置、三次重复下度量 Pass@1 与诊断对比等指标。
evidence_note: 300 任务覆盖 167 仓库/85 CWE/5 语言生态、固定分析环境、CheckerLab 独立重建提交物、21 配置×3 重复的可复现协议与确定性指标；无统计检验但重复设计充分。
novelty_note: 首个评估智能体端到端开发静态分析检查器能力的可执行基准：任务形态（读规范→写检查器→迭代修复）与评估协议（独立重建+诊断对比）均为新设定。
scope: 结论适用于五语言生态的仓库级检查器合成任务与所测 21 个模型-脚手架组合；跨语言差异归因与真实安全团队工作流的对齐未验证。
limitations: 任务锚定 CVE 修复，检查器需求由规范转写，可能窄于真实检查器开发；Pass@1 未覆盖多次交互后的上限；评估环境的构建复杂度限制复现成本。

title: Safeguarding LLMs via Model-Agnostic Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge
abstract: LLMs have advanced rapidly, raising growing concerns about their safety. Recent work has proposed approaches to detect and defend against attacks including defenses at decoding stage that leverage models' hidden states. However, existing decoding-stage defenses suffer from two limitations. First, they introduce a trade-off between safety and over-refusal, where strengthening safety degrades the model's helpfulness on benign queries. Second, many of these methods rely on internal hidden states and are thus restricted to specific architectures, incurring substantial overhead and limited generalization across models. To address these limitations, we introduce LADE (Latent Safety Signals for Defense), which leverages latent safety signals extracted by contrasting harmful and benign queries from dark knowledge (i.e., information carried by the output probability distribution beyond its argmax) in the first-token output probability distribution. Our key insight is that, beyond surface-level refusal tokens, the dark knowledge in the first-token distribution contains latent safety signals, defined as tokens whose probabilities differ sharply between harmful and benign queries. We show that these signals consistently align across LLMs, forming a model-agnostic direction that emerges from safety alignment. LADE consists of three components: (1) Extracting Latent Safety Signals from Dark Knowledge, which selects top-k safety-discriminative tokens from the first-token probability distribution; (2) Tokenizer Mapping, which maps these tokens across different tokenizers to enable model-agnostic application; and (3) kNN-based Discrimination, which classifies queries via a k-Nearest Neighbors search over the mapped tokens. Across diverse LLMs and benchmarks, LADE is robust against a wide range of jailbreak attacks and lowers attack success rates while maintaining a competitive safety-utility trade-off.

title_cn: 经暗知识的模型无关潜在安全信号防护 LLM
abstract_cn: LLM 发展迅速，安全关切随之增长。近期工作提出检测与防御攻击的方案，包括利用模型隐藏状态的解码阶段防御。但现有解码阶段防御有两个局限：其一，安全与过度拒言之间存在权衡，加强安全会降低模型对良性查询的有用性；其二，许多方法依赖内部隐藏状态，受限于特定架构，开销可观且跨模型泛化有限。为解决这些局限，我们提出 LADE（Latent Safety Signals for Defense），利用从「暗知识」——输出概率分布中 argmax 之外承载的信息——的首 token 概率分布中对比有害与良性查询提取的潜在安全信号。关键洞察是：在表层拒答 token 之外，首 token 分布的暗知识包含潜在安全信号，即概率在有害与良性查询间显著不同的 token。我们证明这些信号跨 LLM 一致对齐，形成一个由安全对齐涌现的模型无关方向。LADE 包三部分：(1) 从暗知识提取潜在安全信号，从首 token 分布选 top-k 安全判别 token；(2) 分词器映射，把这些 token 跨不同分词器映射以实现模型无关应用；(3) 基于 kNN 的判别，通过映射 token 上的 k 近邻搜索分类查询。跨多个 LLM 与基准，LADE 对广泛越狱攻击保持稳健，在降低攻击成功率的同时保持有竞争力的安全-效用权衡。
summary_cn: LADE 从首 token 分布的暗知识提取跨模型对齐的潜在安全信号，经分词器映射+kNN 判别实现模型无关解码防御，对广泛越狱降低 ASR 并保持安全-效用权衡。
objective_summary: 提出从首 token 概率分布暗知识中提取跨模型对齐的安全判别 token 并以分词器映射+kNN 实现模型无关越狱判别的解码阶段防御 LADE，跨多模型与基准评估安全-效用权衡。
evidence_note: 多 LLM 家族与多越狱基准上的 ASR 与效用对比、跨分词器映射的迁移实验、与既有解码防御的权衡比较；无统计检验，防御的超参数（top-k、k）敏感性未详述。
novelty_note: 信号源从隐藏状态转向首 token 分布暗知识、并以跨分词器 token 映射实现模型无关，是解码防御中实质性的新机制组合；「安全信号跨模型对齐」的发现有独立价值。
scope: 结论适用于可获取首 token 概率分布的开源/开放接口模型；对仅返回文本的闭源 API、分布外攻击类型与自适应规避（伪造首 token 分布）未评估。
limitations: 需访问输出概率分布，闭源部署受限；top-k 信号的选择依赖参考有害/良性查询集；kNN 判别的误报对良性长尾查询的影响未系统量化。

title: BVI: Lightweight, Data-Centric Blockchain-Based Verification of Identity Claims
abstract: A person who answers an unexpected call claiming to come from a bank has no way to check the claim. Australian text messaging has labelled a message as unverified when the sender identifier is not registered since 1 July 2026, but a voice call still arrives with nothing behind it, and voice cloning has removed the last cue recipients relied on. We present BVI, which answers one question for the recipient: did the calling party prove it holds a credential a registered organisation issued for this call? BVI keeps the organisational record, its authorised channels and its revocation state on a public ledger in a directly queryable form, and puts all decision logic in the handset, which performs eleven checks, pays no transaction fee and holds no full-chain state. We define ten attack classes plus the case in which revocation cannot be resolved, compare them in a 10-by-4 coverage matrix spanning BBCA, the content digest, the detector and composed BVI, and run 27 automated scenario tests against isolated Hardhat fixture states of the BVI contract; all 27 pass. For media substitution and synthetic speech, the contract tests validate commitment and gating properties rather than claiming detector accuracy. The mandatory per-session anchor costs about 91.5k gas and is invariant in call duration and hop count; each participating intermediary additionally contributes one optional attestation write. In a 20,000-session-per-cell path simulation, at one quarter carrier participation BVI detects 20.6 per cent of randomly located in-path rewrites versus 0.1 per cent for the every-hop comparison, while identity and content evidence remain available even when path evidence is indeterminate. We also quantify the throughput ceiling of the anchoring design.
title_cn: BVI：轻量、以数据为中心的基于区块链身份声明验证
abstract_cn: 接到自称来自银行的意外来电的人无从核实这一说法。澳大利亚短信业务自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起对发送者标识未注册的消息标注「未验证」，但语音来电依旧空手而来，而语音克隆已抹去接收者最后依赖的线索。我们提出 BVI，为接收者回答一个问题：主叫方是否证明了它持有某个注册组织为本通电话签发的凭证？BVI 把组织记录、其授权信道与吊销状态以可直接查询的形式放在公共账本上，把全部决策逻辑放在手机端——执行十一项检查、不付交易费、不保存全链状态。我们定义十个攻击类加上吊销无法解析的情形，在横跨 BBCA、内容摘要、检测器与组合 BVI 的 10×4 覆盖矩阵中比较，并对 BVI 合约的隔离 Hardhat 夹具状态运行 27 项自动化场景测试，全部通过。对媒体替换与合成语音，合约测试验证承诺与门控性质而不声称检测器精度。强制的每会话锚定花费约 91.5k gas，且与通话时长和跳数无关；每个参与中介额外贡献一次可选证明写入。在每小区 20,000 会话的路径仿真中，四分之一运营商参与率下 BVI 检出 20.6% 的随机位置路径内改写，对比逐跳方案的 0.1%，且当路径证据不确定时身份与内容证据仍然可用。我们还量化了锚定设计的吞吐上限。
summary_cn: BVI 用公共账本验证来电组织凭证、手机端执行 11 项检查：27 项合约场景测试全过，每会话锚定约 91.5k gas；1/4 运营商参与下检出 20.6% 路径内改写（逐跳方案 0.1%）。
objective_summary: 设计把组织凭证记录放公共账本、决策逻辑全部置于手机端的来电身份声明验证协议 BVI，以攻击类覆盖矩阵、合约场景测试与路径仿真评估安全性、gas 成本与检测率。
evidence_note: 27 项自动化 Hardhat 合约场景测试全过、10×4 攻击覆盖矩阵比较、20,000 会话/小区路径仿真与 gas 实测（91.5k）；测试为合约性质验证而非端到端真实运营商部署，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 针对语音克隆时代来电验证给出「凭证持有证明」式新协议形态：账本仅存可查询记录、全部逻辑下沉手机端，每会话锚定成本与跳数解耦是差异化设计。
scope: 结论适用于合约层与仿真层验证的组织来电场景；实际运营商参与激励、跨国际电话路由与监管落地未验证；检测器精度不在主张范围内。
limitations: 安全结论限于十一项检查与所定义攻击类；1/4 参与率下 20.6% 检出率意味着多数改写仍未检出；吞吐上限与账本扩展性的量纲依赖链上参数假设。

title: Not What a Child Expressed: Auditing the Sign-to-Text Safety Interface in Child-Facing AI
abstract: Automatic sign language translation (SLT) has entered consumer products, turning American Sign Language into English text for dictation, messaging, and queries put to a conversational assistant. Child-facing AI and platform trust-and-safety tooling decide on text, using filters on minor accounts and grooming classifiers that score chat messages. A signing child who uses SLT therefore reaches these safeguards through a translation. We found no publicly documented system in which the two have been jointly evaluated, and the leading deployed SLT model was neither trained nor formally evaluated on signers under 18. Errors that alter negation, participant roles, secrecy, urgency or help-seeking could change a safety decision without disturbing fluency. This paper proposes a Deaf-informed pre-deployment audit of that boundary, with a failure taxonomy, a sanitised scenario schema, four comparison conditions, and four outcome measures. Auslan is the planned first case study.

title_cn: 不是孩子表达的：儿童面向 AI 中手语转文本安全接口的审计
abstract_cn: 自动手语翻译（SLT）已进入消费产品，把手语转成英文文本用于听写、消息和向对话助手的提问。面向儿童的 AI 与平台信任安全工具基于文本决策：未成年人账号的过滤器、为聊天消息打分的诱骗分类器。使用手语的听障儿童因此经由一次翻译抵达这些安全机制。我们没有找到任何一个公开记载的系统对两者做过联合评估，而已部署的领先 SLT 模型既未在 18 岁以下手语者上训练、也未做正式评估。改变否定、参与者角色、隐秘性、紧急性或求助表达的翻译错误，可能在不破坏流畅性的情况下改变安全决策。本文提出对该边界的聋人主导式部署前审计，含失败分类学、净化的场景模式、四个对照条件与四项结果度量。澳式手语（Auslan）是计划的首个案例研究。
summary_cn: 立场论文：手语儿童经 SLT 翻译抵达平台安全过滤器，两者从未被联合评估，改变否定/隐秘性/求助的翻译错误可无声改变安全决策；提出聋人主导的部署前审计框架。
objective_summary: 指出 SLT 翻译与平台文本安全工具之间从未被联合评估的接口风险，提出含失败分类学、场景模式、对照条件与结果度量的聋人主导式部署前审计方案。
evidence_note: 无经验验证：基于系统接口检视与文献梳理提出审计框架，案例研究（Auslan）为计划中未执行；NeurIPS 2026 儿童安全 workshop 海报（非存档）。
novelty_note: 首次把「手语→文本→安全决策」这条翻译中介的安全接口作为独立审计对象提出：指出 negation/求助等五类语义错误可无声改变安全结果，问题本身新颖。
scope: 结论适用于以文本决策为终点的儿童面向 AI 与 SLT 翻译管线；对具体翻译模型的错误率与真实安全事件影响未量化（尚无实验）。
limitations: 纯立场与框架，无实验数据；审计方案的可行性未经案例验证；对各类 SLT 模型错误分布的刻画依赖后续工作。

title: Harmful SFT Leaves a Continuous Trace in LLM Checkpoint Updates
abstract: Safety auditing of post-trained large language models typically relies on model behavior, requiring model execution and depending on the coverage of available evaluations. This work asks a different question: Do the target behaviors optimized during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leave readable evidence directly in checkpoint updates? We find that harmful-compliance SFT induces a continuous, objective-dependent ordering in checkpoint-update space. Using a reference geometry defined by pure harmful-compliance, safety-targeted, and benign-utility SFT, we find that a checkpoint-level coordinate s_H tracks controlled harmful-objective composition with Spearman correlations of 0.986-0.992 across four 7-8B backbones, with the same ordering persisting at larger model scales. Matched compliance-versus-refusal controls show that this checkpoint trace reflects the SFT objective rather than harmful-input exposure, while additional controls rule out simple explanations based on harmful-example count or generic training intensity. Building on this structure, we introduce TRACE, a weights-only auditing method that localizes an unknown checkpoint update relative to frozen harmful and non-harmful reference prototypes and converts this geometry into a continuous harmful-objective score. TRACE requires neither model queries nor access to the unknown SFT data, and can be evaluated directly from checkpoint updates. Across distribution shifts, unseen data, different SFT configurations, partial checkpoint access, and LoRA/full-parameter fine-tuning, the trace remains stable and is positively associated with independently measured attack success rates. TRACE remains informative even at low harmful-objective proportions, providing a complementary auditing signal when behavioral evaluation is unavailable or incomplete. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Code4TRACE-54D3.
title_cn: 有害 SFT 在 LLM 检查点更新中留下连续痕迹
abstract_cn: 对后训练 LLM 的安全审计通常依赖模型行为，需要执行模型且受可用评估覆盖面制约。本工作提出另一个问题：监督微调（SFT）期间优化的目标行为，是否会直接在检查点更新中留下可读证据？我们发现有害顺从 SFT 会在检查点更新空间中诱发连续的、依赖目标的排序。使用由纯有害顺从、安全定向与良性效用 SFT 定义的参考几何，检查点级坐标 s_H 与受控有害目标成分的 Spearman 相关达 0.986–0.992（四个 7–8B 底座），且同一排序在更大模型规模上保持。匹配的顺从对比拒绝控制表明该检查点痕迹反映 SFT 目标而非有害输入暴露，附加控制排除了有害样本数量或一般训练强度等简单解释。基于该结构，我们提出 TRACE——仅凭权重的审计方法，把未知检查点更新相对冻结的有害与非有害参考原型定位，并把该几何转换为连续的有害目标分数。TRACE 不需要模型查询、也不需要访问未知 SFT 数据，可直接从检查点更新评估。跨分布偏移、未见数据、不同 SFT 配置、部分检查点访问与 LoRA/全参微调，该痕迹保持稳定并与独立测量的攻击成功率正相关。TRACE 在低有害目标比例下仍有信息量，为行为评估不可用或不完整时提供互补审计信号。代码见 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Code4TRACE-54D3。
summary_cn: TRACE 仅从检查点更新审计 SFT 目标：s_H 坐标与有害成分 Spearman 0.986–0.992（四个 7–8B 底座），无需模型查询或 SFT 数据，跨分布/LoRA/部分访问稳定且与 ASR 正相关。
objective_summary: 发现有害顺从 SFT 在检查点更新空间诱发目标依赖的连续排序（Spearman 0.986–0.992），据此构建仅凭权重的审计方法 TRACE 并跨分布、配置与访问条件验证其稳定性。
evidence_note: 四个 7–8B 底座的受控 SFT 实验、匹配顺从/拒绝对照、多重混淆控制（样本量、训练强度）、跨 LoRA/全参与部分访问的稳定性检验，并与独立测量的 ASR 相关验证；无正式统计检验但控制充分。
novelty_note: 开辟「从检查点更新读出训练目标」的权重审计新信号源：不依赖行为评估与训练数据访问，且给出参考几何构建与低比例有害目标的敏感性证据。
scope: 结论适用于 SFT 后的 7–8B 级开源权重模型与可获取检查点更新差分的审计场景；RLHF/PPO 阶段、闭源黑盒模型与混淆性多目标混合微调未覆盖。
limitations: 参考几何依赖预制的有害/良性 SFT 原型，其代表性影响分数校准；对刻意掩盖目标方向的对抗性微调鲁棒性未测；更大模型规模仅初步验证排序保持。

title: Understanding and Enhancing Backdoor Persistency in LLM Agent Post-Training
abstract: Developers can build LLM agents by adapting third-party models through benign post-training. We study a supply-chain threat in which an attacker supplies a model with a backdoor: hidden behavior that produces malicious outputs when a particular input pattern appears. Focusing on software-engineering agents, we ask whether such backdoors survive the developer's supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and subsequent task-level reinforcement learning (RL). We observe that benign SFT substantially reduces attack success, but subsequent RL often preserves the residual behavior and sometimes even increases attack success. Our analysis of backdoor erosion during SFT identifies two factors that may favor survival: initial backdoor strength and gradient compatibility with benign training. These factors motivate PersistBD, which refines an already-backdoored model before release to improve its persistency through the benign post-training process. On Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, PersistBD raises attack success from 20% to 74% after SFT and from 20% to 76% after SFT-RL, while maintaining comparable benign task performance. Together, our results show that backdoors can remain active through benign post-training and that adversaries can deliberately increase their persistence. This highlights a supply-chain risk for AI developers and motivates stronger techniques for detecting and mitigating inherited backdoors when adapting third-party models into agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/uiuc-kang-lab/PersistBD.

title_cn: 理解并增强 LLM 智能体后训练中的后门存续性
abstract_cn: 开发者可以通过对第三方模型做良性后训练来构建 LLM 智能体。我们研究一种供应链威胁：攻击者供用一个带后门的模型——当特定输入模式出现时产生恶意输出的隐藏行为。聚焦软件工程智能体，我们追问这类后门能否在开发者的监督微调（SFT）与后续任务级强化学习（RL）中存活。我们观察到良性 SFT 大幅降低攻击成功率，但后续 RL 常常保留残余行为，有时甚至提高攻击成功率。对 SFT 期间后门侵蚀的分析识别出两个可能利于存活的因子：初始后门强度与和良性训练的梯度兼容性。这些因子促成了 PersistBD——在发布前精炼已带后门的模型，提高其在良性后训练过程中的存续性。在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 上，PersistBD 把 SFT 后攻击成功率从 20% 提到 74%、SFT+RL 后从 20% 提到 76%，同时保持相当的良性任务表现。我们的结果表明后门可在良性后训练后仍活跃，且对手可以有意提高其存续性。这凸显了 AI 开发者面临的供应链风险，并促使在把第三方模型适配为智能体时采用更强的继承后门检测与缓解技术。代码见 https://github.com/uiuc-kang-lab/PersistBD。
summary_cn: 后门在良性后训练中可存续：SFT 压低 ASR 后 RL 常保留甚至回升；PersistBD 在 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 上把 SFT/SFT-RL 后 ASR 从 20% 提到 74%/76%（EMNLP 2026 Findings）。
objective_summary: 系统测量第三方后门模型在开发者 SFT 与任务级 RL 中的存续性，识别初始强度与梯度兼容性两个存活因子，并提出增强存续性的 PersistBD 精炼方法。
evidence_note: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 上 SFT 与 SFT+RL 两阶段的受控测量（ASR 20%→74%/76%）、存活因子分析与良性任务性能对照，EMNLP 2026 Findings 录用，代码公开；底座单一。
novelty_note: 把「后门经良性后训练是否存活」作为供应链威胁系统量化，并反向提出提高存续性的攻击侧精炼方法——攻击面与防御需求两侧都有实质新意。
scope: 结论适用于软件工程智能体的 SFT+RL 后训练管线与 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 级底座；其他智能体形态、更大模型与偏好优化类后训练未覆盖。
limitations: 实验底座单一（7B 编码模型）；后门触发模式由攻击者构造，覆盖的触发类型有限；防御侧（继承后门检测）只作为动机提出、未实现评估。

title: Deep Defence on Wheels: A Dual Intrusion Detection System Architecture for Comprehensive In-Vehicle Network Security
abstract: Increasing connectivity to the outside world and the lack of inbuilt security mechanisms have made legacy intra-vehicular networks vulnerable to cyberattacks. Initial research focused on maximising detection accuracy for known and unknown attacks, often using large, full-precision machine learning models. However, embedding IDSs into vehicular electronic systems also requires low detection latency, energy efficiency and minimal electronic control unit (ECU) resource overhead to process about 2,000 CAN frames/s. Lightweight models must balance accuracy with these deployment constraints. We propose a dual IDS framework comprising supervised and unsupervised learning-based solutions, each optimised for real-time, resource-constrained automotive platforms. A quantised LSTM-based IDS (QLSTM-IDS) achieves over 99.9% detection accuracy for DoS/Flooding, Fuzzing and Spoofing/Malfunction attacks using a single model architecture evaluated on two widely used datasets. The model is trained using the Brevitas quantisation-aware training library, transformed into a dataflow accelerator with custom blocks compatible with AMD's FINN toolchain, and synthesised using Vitis HLS. Complementing this, an 8-bit quantised convolutional autoencoder-based IDS (QCAE-IDS), quantised using AMD's Vitis-AI toolchain, detects previously unseen anomalies that alter CAN-ID sequence patterns with over 99% accuracy. An integration architecture enables both models to operate on a single FPGA, bridging the network interface IP and processing system to minimise software overhead. QLSTM-IDS achieves 0.25 ms inference latency and 0.8 mJ energy consumption per message, while QCAE-IDS achieves 0.42 ms and 1.1 mJ per block. Both solutions are deployed and evaluated on the ZCU104 SoC (XCZU7EV FPGA), demonstrating a flexible hardware/software co-design for real-time detection of known and unknown attacks on high-speed CAN buses.

title_cn: 车轮上的纵深防御：面向车内网络全面安全的双入侵检测系统架构
abstract_cn: 与外界的连接日益增多而内置安全机制缺失，使传统车内网络易受网络攻击。早期研究聚焦于最大化对已知与未知攻击的检测精度，常用大型全精度机器学习模型；但把 IDS 嵌入车辆电子系统还要求低检测时延、能效与最小 ECU 资源开销，以处理约每秒 2,000 帧 CAN 报文。轻量模型必须在精度与这些部署约束间权衡。我们提出由监督与无监督学习方案组成的双 IDS 框架，各自针对实时、资源受限的汽车平台优化。量化 LSTM IDS（QLSTM-IDS）用单一模型架构在两个广泛使用的数据集上对 DoS/洪泛、Fuzzing 与欺骗/故障攻击达到 99.9% 以上检测精度；模型用 Brevitas 量化感知训练库训练，转换为与 AMD FINN 工具链兼容的自定义块的数据流加速器，并用 Vitis HLS 综合。与之互补，8 位量化卷积自编码器 IDS（QCAE-IDS，用 AMD Vitis-AI 工具链量化）以 99% 以上精度检测改变 CAN-ID 序列模式的未见异常。集成架构使两模型在单块 FPGA 上运行，桥接网络接口 IP 与处理系统以最小化软件开销。QLSTM-IDS 达到每报文 0.25 毫秒推理时延与 0.8 毫焦能耗，QCAE-IDS 每块 0.42 毫秒与 1.1 毫焦。两方案均部署并评估于 ZCU104 SoC（XCZU7EV FPGA），展示了在高速 CAN 总线上实时检测已知与未知攻击的灵活软硬件协同设计。

title: Can Power Draw Constrain Covert Compute? Limits of Analogue Verification for AI Governance
abstract: Frontier AI treaties or agreements on limiting computation require external verification; an external auditor must be able to confirm how much computation actually ran and that parties are adhering to the agreement. Analogue, off-chip measurements such as power draw provide an information channel for verification. It is unknown how well these analogue channels can constrain computation against an adversary who actively tries to subvert the audit. We derive a closed form for $\beta$, the largest hidden computation a power trace cannot exclude, as a fraction of the declared machine capacity. Measurements on NVIDIA A100 GPUs constrain $\beta = 1.16$ in the worst case, while adversarial matched-energy strategies are shown to hide at least $\beta = 0.41$ of compute. Analogue power measurements alone therefore constrain compute weakly. Additional restrictions granted by the threat model, such as the ability of the verifier to re-execute the declared work at an observed operating point, let the verifier push $\beta$ down to $0.059$ in the maximally restricted case. This gives a quantitative estimate of what analogue measurements can contribute to compute verification.

title_cn: 功耗能否约束隐蔽算力？AI 治理中模拟验证的极限
abstract_cn: 限制算力的前沿 AI 条约或协议需要外部验证；外部审计员必须能确认实际运行了多少计算、各方是否遵守协议。功耗等片外模拟测量提供了验证的信息通道，但对主动破坏审计的对抗者，这些模拟通道能在多大程度上约束计算仍属未知。我们推导 β 的闭式解——功耗曲线无法排除的最大隐藏计算，以声明机器容量的比例计。对 NVIDIA A100 GPU 的测量在最坏情形约束 β=1.16，而对抗性等耗能策略被证明至少能隐藏 β=0.41 的算力。因此仅靠模拟功耗测量对算力的约束很弱。威胁模型授予的附加限制——例如验证者能在被观测工作点重执行所声明的工作——可把 β 压到最大受限情形的 0.059。这给出了模拟测量能为算力验证贡献多少的定量估计。

objective_summary: 推导功耗测量无法排除的最大隐藏算力比例 β 的闭式表达，用 NVIDIA A100 实测与对抗性等耗能策略量化不同威胁模型下模拟验证的约束强度。

title: NetAgent: Multi-Task Agentic Network Traffic Analysis Made Practical
abstract: Network traffic analysis is central to network security, spanning tasks from intrusion detection to encrypted traffic classification. Existing approaches either train task-specific models that generalize poorly or rely on costly traffic foundation models that still struggle under distribution shift. We present NetAgent, the first agentic framework for multi-task traffic analysis. Through a carefully designed agent loop, NetAgent supports complex task understanding, on-the-fly decomposition and orchestration, dynamic replanning, and long-horizon analysis, without task-specific training. It introduces five key designs: (1) knowledge-augmented workflow planning that maps attack knowledge to traffic features to bridge the semantic gap; (2) a comprehensive tool action space with 150+ verified tools extracted from 50+ published systems; (3) a unified code execution space for flexible action composition; (4) a three-tier memory for long-term knowledge consolidation; and (5) sandboxing and runtime repair for reliable execution. Across 9 major benchmarks, NetAgent outperforms all baselines (23 single-task and 5 multi-task) on nearly all tasks and generalizes substantially better to unseen traffic distribution (90.04% F1 vs. 2.74% and 3.04% for the best single-task and multi-task baselines) and under realistic background shift (4.85-point F1 drop vs. 74.88-point and 74.80-point drop for the best single-task and multi-task baselines). These results reveal that existing methods owe much of their reported success to overfitting dataset-specific patterns and degrade sharply in realistic network environments, while NetAgent's agentic design remains accurate, generalizable, and robust.

title_cn: NetAgent：迈向实用的多任务智能体网络流量分析
abstract_cn: 网络流量分析是网络安全的核心，涵盖从入侵检测到加密流量分类的任务。现有方法要么训练泛化差的任务专用模型，要么依赖在分布偏移下仍然吃力的昂贵流量基础模型。我们提出 NetAgent，首个面向多任务流量分析的智能体框架。通过精心设计的智能体循环，NetAgent 支持复杂任务理解、即时分解与编排、动态重规划与长程分析，且无需任务专用训练。它引入五项关键设计：(1) 用攻击知识到流量特征的映射弥合语义鸿沟的知识增强工作流规划；(2) 从 50 多个已发表系统提取、150 多个已验证工具的全面工具动作空间；(3) 支持灵活动作组合的统一代码执行空间；(4) 巩固长期知识的三层记忆；(5) 保障可靠执行的沙箱与运行时修复。在 9 个主要基准上，NetAgent 在几乎所有任务上超过全部基线（23 个单任务与 5 个多任务），并对未见流量分布泛化显著更好（F1 90.04%，对比最佳单任务与多任务基线的 2.74% 与 3.04%），在真实背景偏移下也更稳健（F1 降 4.85 点，对比基线的 74.88 与 74.80 点）。这些结果揭示现有方法报告的成功很大程度上依赖对数据集特定模式的过拟合，在真实网络环境中急剧退化，而 NetAgent 的智能体设计保持准确、可泛化且稳健。
